Twenty-four little-endian addresses from $4400 through $4798, increasing by 40 bytes per row. The address calculation at $B7C6 indexes this table by its calculated row and adds a column; adding $94 to the high byte maps the corresponding screen address into colour RAM.

Increment $C61E; when it reaches 2 clear it and return. Otherwise, if $A0CF is not $10 and $C61B is nonzero, jump to $C703; if $A0CF is $10 and $C61D is zero, take the same jump. Otherwise increment $C61A, replacing $E0 with $70, and continue at $C658.
